text:
jen: Kicking off canary for release/2026-05-14 - routing 5% to embeddings.service. Change window 09:00-13:00 PT. I'll watch SLOs for 20m. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-05-14 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started - job=canary-2026-05-14-5pct, target=embeddings.service, routing=5% :rocket:

omar: Observability: embeddings.p95 jumped to ~640ms at 1742001170 (baseline ~280ms). 5xx rate up from 0.04% -> 0.9% in last 4m. dashboard: https://obs.redwood/dash/embeds

sre-oncall: Alert filter firing: slo_alert(embeds/p95>600ms,5m) for deploy_tag=canary. Can you paste the alert filter used?

omar: Query: ```
err = sum(rate(http_responses_total{route=\"/v1/embeddings\",code!~\"2..\",deploy_tag=\"canary\"}[5m]))
req = sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=\"/v1/embeddings\",deploy_tag=\"canary\"}[5m]))
err/req > 0.008
```

jen: Traces show a flurry of upstream 502s and some "connection reset by peer" in worker logs around 1742001165. Any recent config diffs?

deploy-bot: Config diff uploaded: https://ci.redwood/config-diffs/2026-05-14/canary. Notable changes: increased async_batch_window from 3ms -> 10ms; enabled experimental kvcache prefill.

sre-oncall: Larger batch window could explain p95. 502s look like upstream overload from big batches. Proposal: pause canary, revert batch_window to 3ms for canary nodes, run synthetic probe. Agree?

jen: I prefer pause + pin model variant to previous stable as an extra safeguard. Pause first so we stop user impact.

/deploy pause canary job=canary-2026-05-14-5pct (requested by jen)

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Routing set to 0%. Traces sampling increased. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-05-14/1742001180

omar: Applying hotfix: set service.batcher.async_batch_window = "3ms" and pin model to "emb-v1.4.1" for canary pool. Then run synthetic-replay at 10 rps for 90s.

deploy-bot: Config patch applied config-change-1742001200. Starting synthetic job synthetic-verify-1742001205 at 10 rps for 90s.

omar: Synthetic shows p95 ~290ms, errors ~0.02%. No 502s in traces. Clean.

sre-oncall: Good. Plan: resume to 2% for 10m. If p95 < 450ms and error_rate <0.2% continue to 8%. If either breaches, rollback. Rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback canary-2026-05-14 --full`.

jen: Resuming to 2% now. /deploy resume canary job=canary-2026-05-14-5pct target=2% (requested by jen)

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 2%. Observability: high sampling, alert window=5m.

pm-lee: Adding to release notes: "Mitigation: reverted async_batch_window to 3ms and pinned embeddings model to emb-v1.4.1 for canary after latency/502 spike caused by larger batches; added batcher preflight checks."

jen: Marking REL-2026-05-14 as PAUSED->PATCHED->RESUMED(2%). I'll file postmortem actions: preflight for batch-window changes, and add a regression test that simulates kvcache/prefill impacts on batch sizing. :spiral_notepad:

sre-oncall: I'll monitor for the rest of the window and be ready to execute rollback if threshold crossed. Good job on quick mitigation.

deploy-bot: Thread summary saved to REL-2026-05-14. Canary status: PAUSED->PATCHED->RAMPED(2%). Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-05-14/summary-1742001291

jen: Thanks all. We'll reconvene if metrics drift. :thumbsup:
